item.title: Vedanta reportedly in talks to sell a stake in KCM
item.description: Vedanta Resources is in talks to sell a minority stake in Konkola Copper Mines, people familiar with the matter said.
item.content:encoded:
Vedanta Resources is in talks to sell a minority stake in Konkola Copper Mines Plc to a Middle East investor, people familiar with the matter said.

Sources said that KCM could invite bids for a new haulage contract after the sale. Vedanta owns 80 percent of KCM and ZCCM-IH owns 20 percent.

item.title: Copperbelt Earthmoving Limited wins load and haul work
item.description: Lubambe Copper Mines Plc has awarded a load and haul contract to Copperbelt Earthmoving Limited.
item.content:encoded: Lubambe Copper Mines Plc has awarded a load and haul contract to Copperbelt Earthmoving Limited for the Lubambe mine.

item.title: Copperbelt Earthmoving Ltd adds trucks
item.description: Copperbelt Earthmoving Ltd bought 20 new haul trucks for its work at the Lubambe mine.
item.content:encoded: Copperbelt Earthmoving Ltd bought 20 new haul trucks for its work at the Lubambe mine.

item.title: Kansanshi invites bids for diesel supply
item.description: Kansanshi Mining Plc invites sealed bids for the supply of diesel to the Kansanshi mine.
item.content:encoded: Kansanshi Mining Plc invites sealed bids from licensed oil marketing companies for the supply of diesel to the Kansanshi mine in Solwezi. The closing date for bids is 15 October 2026.
